Q1_SHORTEST_MEANINGFUL_CHANGE.prose: Atomic observable unit is one completed US session 1d OHLC bar that can advance market_bar_asof / SeriesPack.daily. Weekly/monthly TFs are resampled from daily; no intraday bar contract exists in Desk engine or data_bridge (frequency=1d).

Q2_NATURAL_OBSERVATION_INTERVAL.question: NATURAL OBSERVATION INTERVAL
Q2_NATURAL_OBSERVATION_INTERVAL.prose: Natural observation clock is the completed US equity session bar (barDayKey=America/New_York), not HKT calendar day and not a blind scheduler wake. Observation becomes meaningful only when a new completed 1d bar exists for symbols+QQQ.

Q3_NATURAL_SIGNAL_INTERVAL.question: NATURAL SIGNAL INTERVAL
Q3_NATURAL_SIGNAL_INTERVAL.interval: ≤1 new ORIGINAL_ENGINE emit per new completed market_bar_asof
Q3_NATURAL_SIGNAL_INTERVAL.prose: Signal capture is gated by (new completed bar asof > formal previous) AND ORIGINAL_ENGINE emit with provenance. Identical source_hash+engine_run_id+market_bar_asof → CAPTURED_ALREADY / new_signals=0. Engine may re-scan the same asof without new knowledge. Cadence≠every calendar day; cadence=new asof + genuine emit.

Q10_WAIT_EVEN_IF_SCHEDULER_WOKE.prose: Wake ≠ due. Desk should WAIT unless there is a new completed bar for observation/signal, or enough post-asof bars for a specific horizon maturity resolve.

Q11_CADENCE_ORIGINAL_SEMANTICS_SUPPORT.prose: Original Desk is a daily-bar LIVE_FORWARD scanner with multi-TF resample and multi-horizon maturity. Native cadence = completed US 1d bar boundary + asof/emit/maturity gates — not a preset Desk=daily scheduler answer.
